## Summary

Returns what a standard numbering system (SNS) code refers to, from a DMC or a code. When only a prefix matches, `exact: false`

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Explain what a Standard Numbering System (SNS) code means in a BREX: pass a DMC (the system / subsystem / sub-subsystem / assembly codes are taken from it) or the codes directly. Returns the matched hierarchy with titles; "exact: false" means only a prefix matched.

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brex` | `string` |  |  | Which BREX to use: a file path to a BREX data module (.xml), or a DMC (e.g. "KENBAIKI-A-00-00-00-00A-022A-D", "DMC-" prefix optional) searched in csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR / S1000D_SPEC_DIR. Omit to use the S1000D default BREX found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR. |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders to search for BREX by DMC (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; S1000D_SPEC_DIR is always searched for the S1000D default BREX). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `dmc` | `string` |  |  | A DMC whose SNS part should be looked up. |
| `systemCode` | `string` |  |  | System code (2-3 characters), when not passing dmc. |
| `subSystemCode` | `string` |  |  | Subsystem code (1 character). |
| `subSubSystemCode` | `string` |  |  | Sub-subsystem code (1 character). |
| `assyCode` | `string` |  |  | Assembly code (2 or 4 characters). |
